A thought occured to me, concerning the Tattoo Signal and burn option.

Tattoo Signal [SoC:C]
Cardtype: Action
Burn Option
+1 stealth action. Requires a Seraph.
Put this card on this acting Seraph. This ready Seraph may tap this
card to untap another Black Hand vampire. A minion may have only one
Tattoo Signal.

Now, since a Seraph can have only one Tattoo Signal, once a seraph has
the card, is he still considered eligible for it?

In effect, am I allowed to use the burn option if I already have a
single seraph with Tattoo Signal?

Is he eligible? No.
Is he a minion that meets the requirements (that is: is he a Seraph)? Yes.

> In effect, am I allowed to use the burn option if I already have a
> single seraph with Tattoo Signal?

No.

If the card said "Requires a Seraph that does not have a Tattoo
Signal", you could then use the Burn Option. The Burn Option rules
doesn't care if you have the pool or blood to pay for a card, only if
you meet the Clan/Discipline/bold-face "Requires" line.
